68.name: Episode 1
68.overview: Jools welcomes global star Niall Horan, London legends Squeeze, dance pop duo TOMORA, blues poet aja monet and Bristol duo Getdown Services.

68.name: Episode 2
68.overview: Jools welcomes musician and producer James Blake, blues guitarist Joe Bonamassa, rising star Sekou, country artist Ashley McBryde, Manchester’s Mandy, Indiana and legend Jocelyn Brown.

68.name: Episode 3
68.overview: Jools welcomes vocal powerhouse Jessie Ware, pop star Holly Humberstone, prolific producer Jack Antonoff, soul singer Samm Henshaw, electro duo Fcukers and director Tim Pope.

68.name: Episode 4
68.overview: With performances from Ellie Goulding, Mitski, Pigeon, Wesley Joseph and Westside Cowboy, and chats with jazz legend Courtney Pine and pop icon Simon Le Bon.

68.name: Episode 5
68.overview: With Lola Young, Mike D 5D, Baby Rose, Wasia Project, Beverly Glenn-Copeland and Elizabeth Copeland, and Bonnie 'Prince' Billy.

68.name: Episode 6
68.overview: Jools welcomes queen of country pop Shania Twain, global star Sam Smith, poet and songwriter Arlo Parks, Quebec duo Angine de Poitrine and Geordie jazz band Knats.

69.name: Episode 1
69.overview: Jools is joined by Paul Heaton, Skye Newman, DC3, mary in the junkyard and Dermot Henry, and chats to Johnny Marr.

69.name: Episode 2
69.overview: Jools welcomes rock duo Royal Blood, drummer Moses Boyd, singer and DJ Shygirl, Irish folk group Kingfishr, cellist and singer Ayanna Witter-Johnson and the legendary Tony Iommi.

69.name: Episode 3
69.overview: Jools welcomes Dexys Midnight Runners, Courtney Barnett, Madra Salach, Ibibio Sound Machine, Mulaa Joans and Elkie Brooks to the show.

69.name: Episode 4
69.overview: Jools welcomes Skepta, Jordan Rakei, Bloc Party, Johnny & Lillie Flynn, corto.alto and Rita Wilson.

lastEpisodeToAir.name: Episode 3
lastEpisodeToAir.overview: Jools welcomes Dexys Midnight Runners, Courtney Barnett, Madra Salach, Ibibio Sound Machine, Mulaa Joans and Elkie Brooks to the show.

nextEpisodeToAir.overview: Jools welcomes Skepta, Jordan Rakei, Bloc Party, Johnny & Lillie Flynn, corto.alto and Rita Wilson.
